description:
Generated by grafana/discovery/build-wan-wall.sh from grafana/config/sites.yaml at 2026-10-04T07:10:29Z. Datasource UID zabbix-lab, folder noc. Fixed slot order; itemids resolved live via Grafana→Zabbix resource proxy.

Unified scope (Site / Device type / Device / Interface type / Interface / Direction / Metric). The collapsed row keeps the original fixed WAN link wall unchanged.

panels.title: Interfaces
panels.description: Interfaces of the selected devices that report traffic counters.

panels.title: Oper UP
panels.description: Interfaces whose operational status is up. Only interfaces monitored for status are counted.

panels.title: Oper DOWN / other
panels.description: Interfaces whose operational status is not up (down, testing, lower-layer-down ...).

panels.title: Peak inbound
panels.description: Highest inbound rate of any single selected interface in the time range (a maximum, not a sum, so overlapping interfaces are not counted twice).

panels.title: Peak outbound
panels.description: Highest outbound rate of any single selected interface in the time range.

panels.title: Error / discard counters
panels.description: Error and discard counters (per interface and direction) that counted at least one in the time range.

panels.title: Bandwidth — ${direction:text}
panels.description: One line per selected device and interface. Lines are never added together.

defaults.noValue: NO DATA for the selected devices / interfaces

panels.title: Interface summary (capacity next to traffic)
panels.description: Mean / peak / last value of each metric per interface for the time range; the interface speed (capacity) is its own row, so traffic can be compared with it.

panels.title: Selected metric — ${metric:text}
panels.description: Pick one or more metrics with the Metric selector. Operational status: up = green, down = red.

defaults.noValue: NO DATA — the selected metric is not monitored on these interfaces

panels.title: Original WAN link wall (fixed set of links, not filtered by the selectors)

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.description: Site = Zabbix host group "Site/<name>". All = every monitored host, including hosts without a site group.

list.name: device_group
list.label: Device type
list.description: Device type = Zabbix host group "Type/<name>" (router, switch, ...).

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.description: Devices of the selected site and type. Pick one or several to compare. New Zabbix hosts appear here automatically.

list.name: interface_type
list.label: Interface type
list.description: Interface types by name prefix (Gi, Te, Po, Vl ...). All = every interface. Look at port-channels or VLANs separately to avoid counting overlapping interfaces twice.
list.query: Gigabit Ethernet : Gi, Ten-Gigabit Ethernet : Te, Fast Ethernet : Fa, Ethernet : Eth, Port-channel : Po, VLAN : Vl, Loopback : Lo, Tunnel : Tu

list.name: interface
list.label: Interface
list.description: Interfaces of the selected devices. Series always show "device: interface", so equal names on different devices stay distinguishable.

list.name: direction
list.label: Direction
list.description: Inbound and / or outbound traffic (bandwidth chart and KPI cards).

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.description: What the lower chart shows: bandwidth, operational status, errors or discards, for the selected interfaces. Only metrics monitored on the interface return data.
list.query: Inbound bandwidth : Bits received, Outbound bandwidth : Bits sent, Operational status : Operational status, Inbound errors : Inbound packets with errors, Outbound errors : Outbound packets with errors, Inbound discards : Inbound packets discarded, Outbound discards : Outbound packets discarded

title: NOC — WAN Overview
